raw_response:
I will do it the safe way, mostly the same as last year, with only small adjustment if seed price or fertilizer price changes. On 8 mu, I will keep 6 mu in wheat-maize because that is the steady part for grain, and I will keep 2 mu in cotton so I have one more crop in case one price goes bad. I do not like cutting fertilizer too hard. If I save a little on fertilizer and lose yield, that loss hurts more than wasting one bag. For wheat, I will put enough base fertilizer, water it with my well about 3 times if the spring stays dry, and spray 2 times. For maize after wheat, I will sow quickly so I do not miss soil moisture, give it strong nitrogen, water 2 times, and spray 2 times. For cotton, I will not make the area big, because it takes watching and picking, but I will still feed it well enough and water it 3 times. I watch what the good fields around me do, and I stay close to that. I do not chase fancy changes on 8 mu land when family labor and money both matter.
